featured_reviews.name: Prem Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Chotu’s in Borivali for a quick Chinese fix. Had manchow soup, schezwan lollipop dry, veg schezwan fried rice and chicken Singapore noodles.
Service was very quick and the quantity of both rice and noodles was quite good.
Typical roadside Chinese taste.
The lollipop was a bit on the chewy side but still decent. Manchow soup had a little too much vinegar and soy sauce for my liking. Veg schezwan fried rice was actually really good and something I’d definitely recommend.
One thing to note is the amount of food colour used- definitely not for someone looking for healthy food. Seating is available outside in the compound with around 9 tables and another 6-7 tables inside.
Considering the street-style setup, quick service and low prices, it’s value for money

featured_reviews.name: Meera Wadher
featured_reviews.review_text:
A really decent place for delicious indo-chinese cuisine! They have great quantity & quality of food! A must-try. Ordered spring rolls and a Veg Steak Sizzler, it was sufficient for 3-4 people. Glad to have found this place, pretty underrated + affordable + provides great service. There's some waiting time during weekends, but it's worth it because the food is amazing :)

They don't serve sizzlers on Sundays, so if you're going to try that, go on weekdays/Saturday instead!

Noodles -
They do have an amazing variety of noodles, btw. Tried their veg fried rice, veg hakka noodles and Phad Thai Phak Noodles. The Thai noodles tasted great, had different veggies and an exotic flavor...yummm!

Brownie -
I'm not much of a dessert person, but once I tried their sizzling walnut chocolate brownie, I changed my mind. Loved how the roasted walnut pieces blended in with the scoop of vanilla ice cream🤍

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited for dinner with friends and, though we had to wait over half an hour, we were looking forward to a good time together. Upon entering, we were informed that our seating would be separate, which was disappointing as we wanted to enjoy the evening as a group of 8. After some discussion with the staff, they managed to arrange seating for us together, which we appreciated. The food, however, made up for any earlier issues. We started with Chinese bhel, which had a delightful crunch and unique flavors. The Sanjhi special sizzler was a highlight, full of vibrant taste and satisfying portions. Fried rice was well-prepared, and we ended with a warm brownie that hit the spot. The food was delicious, and we all left feeling happy and satisfied, ultimately making the evening a success despite the initial hiccup. Would recommend for the food, but it might help to check on seating arrangements ahead of time!

featured_reviews.name: Raj Arunachala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Old school Indo-Chinese eatery serving delicious authentic 90s style gaadi-Chinese!

Chhotu’s kitchen is a trip through time. Went for dinner here with a cousin and found myself almost nostalgic.

Folks from the 90s will distinctly remember the taste of Indo-Chinese sold in the gaadis. Their unique smoky flavour was inimitable. You will not find this taste in a restaurant.

We ordered the Manchow soup, with a  Manchurian starter and Triple Schezwan noodles. Everything was perfect flavour-wise. They even give generous amounts of fried noodles and freshly made Schezwan sauce as a side dish much like the old days.

Seating is a bit limited. If you prefer standing they even have a gaadi outside. Service is fast as well. And the prices don’t burn a hole through your pocket!

A definite visit for Indo-Chinese lovers of Mumbai!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Okay, hands down one of the best pure veg spots I’ve visited in Borivali! 🤤
Never thought I’d say this, but Surat-style Cheese Angoori Sabzi was an absolute game-changer, cheesy, creamy, and full of flavour. I finally get the hype!

I also tried their Palak Dal Khichdi served with ghee, papad, and dahi, which felt like a warm hug on a plate. Simple, soulful and honestly, perfect for comfort food cravings.

Now coming to their Dry Fruit Paneer and refreshing mocktails, such a great combo! Sweet, spicy, and rich in all the right ways. If you love fusion with a twist, this one's a must-try.

But the real surprise? Burasi Kebab with that green chutney, melt-in-mouth goodness. And I ended on a high with their Lotus Biscoff Waffle, dessert heaven! 🍯🧇

📍 Located in Borivali West
💸 Cost for two: ₹700 approx
👨‍👩‍👧 Perfect for family dinners, casual dates, or just chilling with your foodie gang.

Verdict:
If you're someone who thinks veg food can’t be exciting, Trishiv Bistro will prove you wrong. Big portions, pocket-friendly prices, and legit flavour bombs! Definitely saving this spot for repeat visits.

Rating: 4.8/5

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I have been a regular customer of Chinese Village since I moved to Gorai four years ago, and it remains my absolute go-to for Chinese cuisine.
​The Highlights:
​The Chinese Food: Truly top-notch! While I’ve noticed the North Indian dishes have become a bit more "average" lately, the Chinese menu remains consistently excellent.
​Quality & Safety: One of the main reasons I keep coming back is the food quality. In four years, I have never had any digestive issues, which speaks volumes about their hygiene and ingredients.
​Service & Atmosphere: The ambiance is lovely, and the staff's hospitality is always warm and welcoming. Their home delivery service is also very reliable and prompt.
​My Personal Recommendations:
If you are visiting or ordering in, you have to try these:
​Kung Pao Chicken
​Teriyaki Chicken
​Chinese Village Special Rice
​Hakka Noodles
​Burnt Garlic Rice
​Chilli Garlic Noodles
​I highly recommend this place if you are craving authentic, high-quality Chinese food!

featured_reviews.review_text: If you love eggs,this is the right place to satisfy your cravings for eggs and enjoy the most wonderful egg dishes.i was in Borivali for some window shopping.After finish up,I decided to sit and dine somewhere and I noticed this restaurant near flea market.I went there to sit and eat.I had ordered Australian fry,Egg lahori,Lasan Kachu and B/K dry which were nice.Food and service is good.I love the Egg lahori very nice.

featured_reviews.name: Srishti Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located close to Borivali station, this place has been serving mouthwatering desi chinese for years now. The ambience and decor is average at best, but that is not the thing regular patrons return here for. Their food sells for itself and it is damn yummy.
Quantity is really good here, usually one dish being enough for two people easily. To add to that, their food is at a very reasonable price. Service is prompt and even though the staff are not highly trained, they do get the job done. We had the following to eat :
Chicken Sweet Corn Soup - Large pieces of perfectly cooked chicken in a thick soup consisting of egg and sweet corn, it felt really good in this cold weather.
Triple Chicken Rice - Yummy fried rice served along with spicy schezwan gravy, it was a perfect match. The gravy was absolutely flavourful and filled with chunks of chicken. It gave the rice some much needed support, as the rice on its own was a bit underwhelming. We would recommend this for the gravy itself..😋

featured_reviews.review_text: One the best chinese food I ever had. I tried Kukus chicken fried rice, Kukus chicken soup and Kukus special noodles. The test is awesome. Restaurant is very clean. Staff have very pleasing personality. I had travelled from Pune to just to eat at this place. I marked it one of the best place to have Chinese in Mumbai. This place is very old and they have maintain the same quality. They do home delivery too with partner delivery app. Kukus Chinese Restaurant is one of the best chinese restaurants in Borivali. It has a great menu, but it has a humble space and in between crowded markets.

featured_reviews.name: jaison gabriel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a regular customer at Vivek’s, but this time the experience was extremely disappointing. The food quality was terrible and completely flavorless, as if it was rushed without care. What made it worse was that this meal was for my parents’ anniversary, and the poor quality ruined what should have been a special day.

Earlier, when the hotel had fewer customers, the quality and customer relationship were much better. Now, with more customers, the attention to regular customers has clearly reduced. Even though we visited the hotel directly and placed the order, we had to wait more than an hour for the food. The staff seemed more focused on online orders, likely because they bring more profit.

This is not the experience I expected from a place I trusted for years. I truly hope the management takes this feedback seriously and works on maintaining food quality and valuing loyal customers.
